name: tincture
description: Herbs steeped in alcohol, then strained.
label_caution: Contains alcohol. Keep away from children.

name: glycerite
description: Herbs steeped in vegetable glycerin, an alcohol-free extract.

name: tea blend
description: Dried herbs mixed for steeping.
label_caution: Check each herb's cautions before drinking.

name: infusion
description: Herbs steeped in hot or cold water, drunk the same day.
label_caution: Keep refrigerated and use within a day.

name: decoction
description: Roots, bark or seeds simmered in water.
label_caution: Keep refrigerated and use within two days.

name: infused oil
description: Dried herbs steeped in a carrier oil, then strained.
label_caution: Use dried herbs only. Throw it out if it turns cloudy or smells off.

name: salve
description: Infused oil set with wax, for the skin.

name: balm
description: A softer or richer salve, often with butters.

name: serum
description: A light blend of oils for the face or hair.

name: face oil
description: Oils chosen for the face.

name: lotion
description: Oil and water blended together.
label_caution: Contains water. Keep cool and use within its date.

name: syrup
description: A strong tea sweetened with honey or sugar.
label_caution: Keep refrigerated. Never give honey to a child under one year old.

name: oxymel
description: Herbs steeped in honey and vinegar.
label_caution: Never give honey to a child under one year old.

name: vinegar
description: Herbs steeped in vinegar.

name: bath salts
description: Salts blended with herbs or oils.

name: bath blend
description: Herbs bundled or bagged for the bath.

name: ritual oil
description: An oil blended for ritual or anointing.

name: loose incense
description: Resins and herbs for burning on charcoal.
label_caution: Burn in an airy room, away from children and pets.

name: smoke-free herb bundle
description: Herbs bundled to hang or keep, not to burn.

name: sachet
description: Herbs sewn or tied in cloth.

name: moon water
description: Water left under the moon.
label_caution: Don't drink it unless it began as clean drinking water and was kept covered.

name: other
description: Anything else you make.
